verdict.rationale: Orrick's own Technology Companies Group page states deal volume: nearly 3,000 venture financings totaling over US$157B in 2023-2025, plus PitchBook top-5 global and #1 Europe rankings. Its regional pages describe stage coverage explicitly: Germany 'from Seed and Series A … through to later Series C+ funding rounds', UK 'all stages of growth from incubation through to exit', and France 'seed to growth capital financings'. Missing for 10: named representative transactions, explicit seed-to-late-stage coverage on the main practice page rather than only on regional pages, and independent corroboration beyond the vendor-cited PitchBook rankings.
